verse.verse_2: then the bearers of weight (the clouds),
verse.verse_5: indeed, that which you are promised is true,
verse.verse_6: and the recompense shall surely happen.
verse.verse_7: By the heaven with its passages,
verse.verse_8: surely, you are in different sayings,
verse.verse_9: and are turned away from him who is turned.
verse.verse_11: who are heedless in the immersion.
verse.verse_12: 'When will the Day of Judgement be' they ask.
verse.verse_13: On that Day they shall be tried at the Fire,
verse.verse_14: 'Taste your trial. This is what you have sought to hasten'
verse.verse_15: The righteous shall live among gardens and fountains,
verse.verse_16: receiving what their Lord will give them because before this they were gooddoers.
verse.verse_17: They slept but a little at night,
verse.verse_18: and at dawn would ask forgiveness,
verse.verse_19: and in their wealth was a share for whosoever asked and for whosoever was prevented.
verse.verse_20: For those with sure belief there are signs in the earth,
verse.verse_21: and also in yourselves. Can you not see?
verse.verse_22: In the sky is your provision and that which you are promised.
verse.verse_23: So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as true as your speech.
verse.verse_24: Have you heard the story of Abraham's honored guests?
verse.verse_25: They entered to him and said: 'Peace' And he replied: 'Peace, you are people unknown to me'
verse.verse_26: So he turned to his household and brought a fattened calf.
verse.verse_27: He set it before them, saying: 'Will you not eat'
verse.verse_28: Then he conceived a fear about them, and they said: 'Have no fear', and gave him the glad tidings that he was to have a knowledgeable son.
verse.verse_29: (Sarah) his wife came with an exclamation and clasped her face, and said: 'Surely, I am a barren old woman'
verse.verse_30: 'Such, says your Lord' they replied: 'He is the Wise, the Knower'
verse.verse_32: They replied: 'We are sent to a sinful nation,
verse.verse_33: so that we bring down stones of clay upon them
verse.verse_34: marked by your Lord for the sinful'
verse.verse_35: So We brought the believers out of that they were in.
verse.verse_36: But We found in it only one household of those who had surrendered themselves,
verse.verse_37: and left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
verse.verse_38: In Moses, too, (there were signs). We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority,
verse.verse_39: but he turned his back with his Assembly, saying: 'He is (either) a sorcerer or a mad man'
verse.verse_40: So We seized him and his hosts and cast them into the sea. Indeed, he was blameworthy.
verse.verse_41: And in Aad. We let loose on them a withering wind
verse.verse_42: that left nothing it came upon, except that it was ashes.
verse.verse_43: And in Thamood it was said to them: 'Take your enjoyment for awhile'
verse.verse_44: But in their pride they turn away from the commandment of their Lord and the thunderbolt struck them whilst they were looking;
verse.verse_45: they could neither stand up straight, nor were they helped.
verse.verse_46: And before them the nation of Noah, indeed they were a debauched nation.
verse.verse_47: We built the heaven with might, and We widely extended it.
verse.verse_48: and We cradled the earth. And We are the Best of Cradlers.
verse.verse_49: We created two kinds of all things, so that you will remember.
verse.verse_50: Therefore, flee to Allah. I am a clear warner to you from Him.
verse.verse_51: Do not set up with Allah another god. I am a clear warner to you from Him.
verse.verse_52: Similarly, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: 'Sorcerer, or mad'
verse.verse_53: Have they handed this down from one to another? No, rather, they are an insolent nation.
verse.verse_54: So turn away from them, you shall not be blamed,
verse.verse_55: But remind, the Reminder will benefit the believers.
verse.verse_56: I have not created mankind and jinn except to worship Me.
verse.verse_57: I do not desire provision from them, nor do I desire that they should feed Me.
verse.verse_58: Surely, Allah is the Provider, the Possessor of Power, the Mighty.
verse.verse_59: The evildoers shall have for their portion, a portion like their companions (who were destroyed before them). Therefore, they should not ask Us to hasten!
verse.verse_60: Woe then to the unbelievers for their Day which they were promised!
